senses.gloss:
ITA-5.66.44 vidagdhāmlam विदग्धाम्लम्
Eye disorder due to over-consumption of sour foods
A disorder characterized by moistening/soddening; itching; dirtiness.

ITA-5.62.20 vidārikā विदारिका
Abscess resembling Puraria tuberosa rhizome
A disorder characterized by a round papule resembling a tuber or vidārī; circular lesion resembling vidārikanda in axilla; circular lesion resembling vidārikanda in groin.

ITA-5.41.1.11 vidārikā-pramehapiḍakā विदारिका-प्रमेहपिडका
Carbuncle
A disorder characterized by a hard boil similar to the tuber Pueraria tuberosa or vidārīkanda.

ITA-5.63.69 vidārī विदारी
Neoplasm of pharynx
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: burning sensation inside the throat; needling pain; swelling; inflammation with putrified flesh; putrefied swelling inside the throat; person sleeping mostly on one side; copper-coloured swelling.

ITA-6.2.6.58 vidāhī विदाही
Substance producing belching, thirst, burning sensation and difficult to digest

ITA-5.73.19 viddhaḥ विद्धः
Penetrating or puncturing deep injury
A disorder characterized by a foreign body which may remain either protruding or have exited through the wound.

ITA-1.5.4 vidyā विद्या
Knowledge, discipline
Systematized knowledge, learning or science.

ITA-4.2.30 vidyudaśanikṛtarogaḥ विद्युदशनिकृतरोगः
Disorders caused by natural disasters
Diseases and conditions subsequent to natural disasters such as thunder, lightning, asteroid impacts and meteor showers on the terrestrial surface.

ITA-5.52.1 vidradhiḥ विद्रधिः
Abscess
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a deep-seated swelling which is broad-based; painful and round or else elongated, located in the bones and affecting skin; blood; muscles and fat; with the gradual production of excessively severe inflammatory swelling due to vitiated dosha. Generally, the condition advances to an open ulcer.

ITA-5.41.1.8 vidradhikā/ vidradhipramehapiḍakā विद्रधिका/ विद्रधि-प्रमेहपिडका
Carbuncle with symptoms including abscess

ITA-7.2.6.4 Duly processed vidruma is employed as a stand-alone medicine vidrumam or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral pharmaceutical formulations. विद्रुमम्
Coral
